items.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports GPU partitioning with NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), which divides one GPU into hardware-isolated partitions so you can run a different model in each or take a right-sized fraction of a newer accelerator. This post shows how two optional API fields place one model per partition, and what we measured against a whole older GPU.
items.zh: SageMaker推理支持多实例GPU分区
items.brief: AWS宣布SageMaker推理端点支持NVIDIA MIG，可将单GPU划分为硬件隔离分区，分别运行不同模型。
items.why: 降低中小企业多模型部署的GPU成本，可作为降本案例讲。

items.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick
items.summary: As we built Amazon Quick, its agents grew from answering questions to taking actions, and the same primitives kept getting rebuilt under different names. This post shares the taxonomy we converged on — triggers, agents, capabilities, and learned context — found by decomposing agentic work into four plain questions: When, What, Who, and How.
items.zh: 亚马逊Quick智能体原语分类体系
items.brief: AWS分享构建Quick时归纳的智能体原语分类：触发器、智能体、能力与习得上下文四类。
items.why: 给企业设计AI工作流提供通用框架，适合做方法论内容。

items.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
items.summary: Learn how to build a serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate that gives AI agents secure, metadata-driven access to an enterprise data lake. Exposing a new dataset requires only a JSON file, with no per-dataset integration code.
items.zh: ECS Fargate上的无服务器MCP数据湖服务
items.brief: AWS介绍在ECS Fargate上构建无服务器MCP服务器，让AI智能体安全访问企业数据湖，新增数据集只需JSON配置。
items.why: 企业接入自有数据的低成本方案，可讲落地路径。

items.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
items.summary: In Part 1 you built one governed agent. Part 2 scales the pattern to an enterprise: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway becomes the single front door and redeems Okta's grant, Cedar policies bind each tool to the agent, a second agent runs on Amazon EKS, and AgentCore Observability traces every allow and deny beside Okta's log in Amazon CloudWatch.
items.zh: 用Okta与AgentCore治理AI智能体访问（下）
items.brief: 第二部分将单智能体治理模式扩展到企业级：AgentCore Gateway统一入口、Cedar策略绑定工具、可观测性追踪。
items.why: 企业AI权限治理与合规参考，适合讲安全落地。

items.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 1
items.summary: An AI agent that acts for a user raises an identity question that per-app OAuth and service accounts leave open: which agent may act for which user, and how you stop it. In this first post of two, you build a task agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that governs access through Okta Cross App Access and AgentCore Identity, and enforces each user's authority.
items.zh: 用Okta与AgentCore治理AI智能体访问（上）
items.brief: 第一篇介绍在Bedrock AgentCore上构建任务智能体，通过Okta跨应用访问控制智能体代用户操作的权限。
items.why: 回应老板关心的AI权限与账号安全，可做科普。

items.title: How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Greenlight Financial resolves more than 90% of up to 4,000 monthly security and risk cases without human intervention using Luna, a tiered multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post covers the architecture, episodic memory for continuous learning, and the expansion from SOC operations into financial risk triage.
items.zh: Greenlight用AgentCore构建自主安全运营
items.brief: Greenlight Financial用基于AgentCore的分层多智能体系统Luna，每月自动处理最多4000起安全风险事件中的90%以上。
items.why: 高说服力企业自动化案例，适合讲AI替代重复岗位。

items.title: Taxbit Assist: A grounded, role-aware AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Taxbit built Taxbit Assist, a cited, permission-aware AI assistant embedded in its enterprise dashboard, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post shows how they grounded answers in a curated knowledge base, enforced role-aware and region-compliant safety, and continuously measured answer quality on live production traffic.
items.zh: Taxbit基于AgentCore的角色感知AI助手
items.brief: Taxbit在企业仪表盘中嵌入可引用来源、按权限与地区合规的AI助手，并持续在线评测回答质量。
items.why: 展示企业级AI助手的合规与质量管控做法。

items.title: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls
items.summary: Run Claude Code as a remote agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Each coding task runs in its own isolated session in your AWS account, every model call goes through Amazon Bedrock, and the result comes back as a GitHub pull request you review and merge.
items.zh: Claude Code 可远程运行于 Amazon Bedrock
items.brief: AWS 发布方案，将 Claude Code 作为远程代理运行在 Bedrock AgentCore，每个编码任务在独立隔离会话中执行，结果以 GitHub PR 返回。
items.why: 企业可借此在自有 AWS 账户内安全试用 AI 编码代理，关注权限与代码审查流程。

items.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
items.summary: A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software, joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development. Together, they give researchers a foundation for testing ideas, comparing results and building on each other’s work — connecting simulation and AI training with experiments on real over-the-air wireless […]
items.zh: NVIDIA 开源工具助力 6G 网络研究
items.brief: NVIDIA 介绍其开源 Aerial 无线软件及 Sionna 等工具，为 6G 研究提供测试与对比基础。

items.summary: arXiv:2611.06995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems have ushered in a new age of proof abundance, but helping humans understand these proofs requires new attention to the differences in how AI agents and humans pursue a proof-making task. We present "simulated collaboration", a methodology that allows us to examine two key questions: (1) the relative attention AI agents pay to surface syntax or, conversely, deeper underlying semantics, and (2) how and where AI agent preferences for what to do next diverge from human preferences. items.zh: 自主AI智能体在证明形式化中系统性偏离人类偏好

items.title: Trust Responsive Runtime Authorization for Agentic AI with Empirical Characterization of Policy Behavior and Parameter Sensitivity
items.summary: arXiv:2611.06996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The policy that converts runtime estimates of an autonomous agent's condition into operational authority is rarely specified or measured. items.zh: 面向智能体AI的信任响应式运行时授权
items.brief: arXiv论文实证刻画TRAP授权策略，将智能体运行时状态映射为操作权限。
items.why: 智能体权限管控机制，对企业AI治理与风控有参考价值。

items.title: Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI
items.summary: arXiv:2611.07048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior, how quickly could they improve, and how can that improvement remain safe? items.title: Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration
items.summary: arXiv:2611.07051v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. items.zh: 闭环智能体评估：分层测量与自校准

items.why: 解决企业AI上线后“是否真在干活”的持续评估难题。

items.zh: 基于上镜图引导探索的合作多智能体强化学习

items.brief: arXiv论文提出跨智能体形式化协议，用Specifier模型翻译临床文本并验证。

items.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

items.brief: OpenAI推出BioBasicsBench，含100项任务，衡量AI智能体解读原始实验数据和处理日常湿实验室工作的能力。
items.why: 偏科研场景，对中小企业老板关联弱。

items.title: The components of agent memory
items.summary: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what’s worth remembering before it knows what’s next. Here’s how “dreaming” helps it organize memory and correct mistakes.
items.zh: Anthropic解析智能体记忆的组成
items.brief: Anthropic工程博客介绍Claude如何通过“做梦”机制整理记忆、纠正错误，从而从经验中学习。
items.why: 帮助理解AI智能体长期记忆能力边界。

items.title: Getting started with Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore returns a synthesized, source-cited answer to a natural-language question in a single tool call, with no search, retrieve, synthesize, and citation pipeline to build. Learn how it works and how to add it to an AgentCore Gateway and call it from an agent.
items.zh: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 推出 Web Answer 功能
items.brief: Web Answer 在单次工具调用中返回带来源引用的合成答案，无需自建搜索、检索、合成与引用流程。

items.zh: 亚马逊用 SageMaker AI 评估商品页内容质量

items.title: Towards Robust Long-Lived Agents: Benchmarking Experience Lifecycles in Evolving Environments

items.zh: 大模型与强化学习驱动的建筑施工进度自动化

items.summary: arXiv:2610.26913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. items.zh: DataPraxis：通过工作区演化扩展分析任务

items.title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.26995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. items.title: Beyond the KV cache: Training and serving i14’s Laplace 3B linear attention model on AWS Trainium2 with native PyTorch
items.summary: Learn how i14 trained and served Laplace 3B, a linear attention model, on AWS Trainium2 using native PyTorch. Its recurrent state stays fixed at 29.5 MB per sequence regardless of context length, avoiding the growing key-value cache of transformer models and keeping serving memory predictable.
items.zh: i14在AWS Trainium2上训练与部署Laplace 3B线性注意力模型
items.brief: AWS介绍i14用原生PyTorch在Trainium2上训练并部署Laplace 3B线性注意力模型，其循环状态固定为每序列29.5MB，不随上下文增长。

items.title: Fine-tuning GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: Learn how we fine-tuned GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and how to decide between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with GRPO. SFT took reasoning-language accuracy from 22% to 100%, and GRPO added measurable gains where headroom existed.
items.zh: 在SageMaker HyperPod上微调GPT-OSS-20B多语言推理

items.brief: Octave用Cohere Embed v4与Bedrock AgentCore搭建多租户AI底座，支撑检索20亿份受监管文件的投诉分诊助手。
items.why: 多租户隔离+合规文档检索，是企业级落地好案例。

items.title: Access OpenAI GPT models on Amazon Bedrock from Canada with cross-Region inference
items.summary: Canadian organizations can now access OpenAI GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and GPT-6.1 models on Amazon Bedrock from the Canada (Central) and Canada West (Calgary) Regions using cross-Region inference. items.why: 代理身份与审计是合规落地前提，值得关注。

Yet assumptions made during planning may be invalidated by the environment, tools may return unexpected results, or actions may fail. Effective agents must therefore not only generate plans, but also revise them. Such revisions often affect only part of a plan, leaving the preceding and subsequent structure intact. items.title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.10833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study whether small LLM agents can operate effectively under explicit wall-clock time budgets by both respecting the allocated runtime and using available time productively. We evaluate Qwen3.6-27B on five competitions from MLE-Bench Lite and Qwen3-4B on Zork I (Jericho), two agentic benchmarks where additional computational time can meaningfully improve performance. items.title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.10942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning environments are now a primary lever for improving large language model (LLM) capabilities in post-training, yet most agentic benchmarks remain static: the world moves only when the agent acts, the reward is a terminal verdict, and the pass bar is set arbitrarily. items.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
items.summary: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. items.zh: 英伟达Omniverse：开发者用前沿AI智能体做仿真
items.brief: 英伟达介绍开发者结合前沿AI模型与Omniverse库，把仿真想法变成可运行应用。

items.title: Pay-per-inference for AI agents: How BlockRun and Incarna use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments gives AI agents a managed way to pay for services on demand, with spending limits enforced by the infrastructure. See how Incarna's agents pay BlockRun for model inference one request at a time over x402, cutting the work of adding x402 payment support from months to days.
items.zh: Bedrock AgentCore 推出按次付费功能
items.brief: AWS 发布 Bedrock AgentCore payments，让 AI 智能体按需付费调用服务，并由基础设施强制消费限额。
items.why: 智能体自动付费有了合规管控方案，可评估企业自动化采购场景。

items.title: Share GPU clusters across teams with isolation and fairness using Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: A reference architecture for securely sharing one Amazon SageMaker HyperPod EKS cluster across multiple teams, using AWS IAM Identity Center for authentication, per-team SageMaker Domains and Kubernetes namespaces for isolation, HyperPod Task Governance for fairness, and namespace-level cost allocation for chargeback.
items.zh: SageMaker HyperPod 多团队共享 GPU 集群方案
items.brief: AWS 发布参考架构，用 IAM、命名空间和任务治理实现多团队安全共享一个 HyperPod 集群。
items.why: GPU 成本高，多团队共享与成本分摊方案对降本有直接参考价值。

items.why: 大企业落地样板，可作培训中讲 AI 提效的现成案例。

items.why: 给老板讲AI降本：模型分级调度是可直接抄的做法。
